name: Heal
description: Nearby allies instantly restore 15% Max HP and increase 15% Movement Speed for 2s

name: Sprint
description: Removes all Slow effects and gain a diminishing (70% - 30%) Movement Speed for 10s

name: Punish
description: Punish: Deals (1350 - 2750) True Damage to a nearby Wildling / Minion and stun them for 1s Frostbite: Simultaneously cast on a nearby enemy, dealing (200 - 410) True Damage with 50% Slow for 2s

name: Execute
description: Instantly attacks nearby enemies, deals True Damage equals Target's 16% Lost HP

name: Flicker
description: Teleports a certain distance in the target direction

name: Roar
description: Increases 25% Resistance and 10% Damage Dealt, while healing 2% Max HP every second over 6s

name: Daze
description: Stuns all nearby enemies for 0.75s Then, reduces Targets' 20% Movement Speed, (28 + Lv*2) Armor, and (14 + Lv) Magic Armor for 2.5s

name: Purify
description: Removes all Debuffs and Control Effects. Gains Super Armor for 1.5s

name: Enfeeble
description: Reduces nearby enemies' 20% Damage Dealt and gains 20% Damage Reduction for 4s
